flue.description: Letting agents control many desktop software, with one pip install, and no MCPs.

skills.description: Let agents control software, like Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere, Autodesk 3DS Max, Blender, Unity, Houdini, and Microsoft Office.

skills/adobe.description: Control Adobe desktop apps - Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, After Effects, InDesign, Audition - from the shell via Flue, without an MCP server.

skills/audition.description: Control Adobe Audition from the shell via Flue - ExtendScript bridges without an MCP server.

skills/autodesk.description: Control Autodesk desktop apps - 3ds Max and friends - from the shell via Flue, without an MCP server.

skills/blender.description: Control Blender from the shell via Flue - a Python bridge to bpy without an MCP server.

skills/figma.description: Control Figma from the shell via Flue - a plugin bridge to the Figma Plugin API without an MCP server.

skills/houdini.description: Control SideFX Houdini from the shell via Flue - a Python bridge to hou without an MCP server.

skills/illustrator.description: Control Adobe Illustrator from the shell via Flue - ExtendScript bridges without an MCP server.

skills/indesign.description: Control Adobe InDesign from the shell via Flue - ExtendScript bridges without an MCP server.

skills/photoshop.description: Control Adobe Photoshop from the shell via Flue - ExtendScript bridges without an MCP server.

skills/premiere.description: Control Adobe Premiere Pro from the shell via Flue - ExtendScript bridges without an MCP server.
